# The back wall, its front face at y 0 (the scene puts it 1.15 m behind the table): navy-blue
# wallpaper from 0.9 to 2.6 m over a wooden wainscot 4 cm proud, with a moulded rail on top.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y, origin on the floor under the middle of the wall.
new
material new Paper --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Paper base-color textures/paper.png
material new Panel --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Panel base-color textures/panel.png
material new Rail --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Paper --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0500 1.7500
scale 6.6000 0.1000 1.7000
apply --scale
material assign Paper
select Paper
active Paper
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name Panel --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0100 0.4500
scale 6.6000 0.1000 0.9000
apply --scale
material assign Panel
select Panel
active Panel
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name Rail --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0400 0.9050
scale 6.6000 0.0800 0.0900
apply --scale
material assign Rail
select Rail
active Rail
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9 || abs(normal.x) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Paper Panel Rail
active Paper
join
shade flat
export wall.glb
